blurb: Guests join tours aboard vessels to see whales, sea lions, seals, otters, eagles, and other wildlife in their natural habitat. Tours run from spring through fall with options including a stable Ocean Cruiser and faster Zodiac boats. The company has a high whale sighting success rate and offers educational experiences about local marine mammals.
extraNote: If no whales are seen, guests may join another tour standby; base fare refunded (taxes and fees apply) · Cancellation policy stated on FAQ page (details not specified) · Departures cannot be delayed for late passengers · 1119 Wharf Street, Victoria's Inner Harbour · March 27 through October 31
